label: People living in flooded areas
aggregation: sum over 1 km cells of population x flooded fraction (scaled up if <100% of the county observed)
notes: Faecal-contamination exposure: about half of households practise open defecation (ISNA 2022-24) and pit latrines flood, so people in flooded cells are exposed to contaminated water (cholera, AWD, hepatitis E). WorldPop places people on their usual settlements; displaced people and dyke-protected towns (Bentiu, Rubkona) are not modelled. Exposure, not measured contamination: no open county-level water-quality data exist for South Sudan. Flood = Sentinel-1 flooded class (VV-VH rise >3 dB over the March reference; reliable Jul-Nov, under-detects receding Dec-Jun water).
source: Derived: Sentinel-1 flood (flood_s1_pipeline.py) x WorldPop R2025A 1 km / oil wells & fields (OSM, GEM GOGET); scripts/flood_exposure.py

label: Flooded area near oil wells/fields (5 km)
aggregation: flooded area within 5 km of any oil well / field point
notes: Oil-pollution spread proxy for Unity, Ruweng and Upper Nile oil fields (Thar Jath, Unity, Toma South, Paloich/Adar...), where produced-water pits, leaking flowlines and spills have been documented (e.g. Sign of Hope / Hoffnungszeichen field studies 2014-2019 in Unity and Ruweng). Only counties with oil infrastructure have values; OSM well locations are incomplete. Exposure, not measured contamination: no open county-level water-quality data exist for South Sudan. Flood = Sentinel-1 flooded class (VV-VH rise >3 dB over the March reference; reliable Jul-Nov, under-detects receding Dec-Jun water).
source: Derived: Sentinel-1 flood (flood_s1_pipeline.py) x WorldPop R2025A 1 km / oil wells & fields (OSM, GEM GOGET); scripts/flood_exposure.py
